ana: Reminder: rehearsal tonight 23:45 UTC — read-replica promotion + routing smoke. Window ~50m. Expect small routing churn but no schema changes.

prashant: Plan summary: promote replica in ap-southeast for 10m, flip 15% of edge traffic for 12m, then revert. Purpose: exercise promotion automation and client retry logic.

lee: Canary schedule: 23:20 start 1% synthetic load, 23:35 increase to 5% if stable, 23:45 promotion. Ill run KV restore probe at 23:30.

ana: Runbook snippet:
```
- 23:25 pause heavy background pipelines
- 23:30 KV restore probe + cache-priming
- 23:35 start canary 5%
- 23:45 promote replica -> primary
- 23:45-23:55 observe: 5xx, p95, retry rate
- 23:55 revert promotion and un-shift traffic
- 00:05 verify caches and synthetic passes
```

prashant: SLO note: temporary relaxation p99 latency from 99.9% -> 99.6% for the rehearsal window. We'll annotate SLO history.

infra-bot: maintenance created: id mnt-1801, start 1786230300, end 1786233600 see /maint mnt-1801

lee: Watching metrics: `db-promotion-duration`, `edge-retry-rate`, `model-kv-hit`. Alert if 5xx > 1% for 5m.

```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s "$CANARY_URL/warm" >/dev/null; done
```
